original_intent: Integrate Dactyl v0.8.2 for Decapod local database writes and complete the Decapod-owned acceptance slice for the requested storage issues.
derived_intent: Replace Decapod-owned direct rusqlite/libsqlite3-sys usage with one Dactyl v0.8.2-backed local storage facade, preserve schema/migration/retry/governance semantics, and prove local failure and reopen behavior.
next_transitions: refresh governance receipt, run final validation, and hand off local completion with hosted cloud gates explicit
resolve container toolchain/runtime validation and historical entrypoint commit-discipline findings before publication
run final lint, targeted/full tests, container validation, and publish the governed workspace when external authorization is supplied
active_boundaries: Dactyl owns physical local execution and typed storage errors; Decapod owns schema, migrations, policy, retry decisions, and governance; hosted Propodus/Neon proof remains external.
repo_scope: Decapod repository source, tests, living specs, generated governance artifacts, and local/container validation only.
evidence: Dactyl v0.8.2 is pinned at tag commit 68555e1; Decapod-owned direct rusqlite/libsqlite3-sys dependencies and SQLite-specific metadata queries are removed; master-side core test edits are present in this workspace.

Managed image supplied libsqlite3.so.0.8.6; Dactyl core conformance 9/9 passed; core library 313/313 passed; core, single-datastore, and SQLite-hardening integration suites passed; new read-write database paths now pass through the v0.8.2 pre-open compatibility preflight.

Validation passed 202 gates and refreshed projections, but the host-side run remains blocked by required container proof and historical entrypoint commit-discipline findings in inherited PR #1256 commits. The prepared container has libsqlite3.so.0.8.6 but its cargo 1.65/rustc 1.63 toolchain cannot parse Rust 2024.
unresolved_assumptions: Cloud Propodus/Vercel/Neon routing and hosted tenancy proof are not integrated and remain downstream work.
Hosted Propodus/Neon deployment, tenancy, credential, and cross-repository transaction proof remain external and are not claimed here.
The local Dactyl runtime proof is complete with the managed image's shared SQLite library; hosted cloud integration and historical governance cleanup remain separate publication gates.
